title: From Monte Carlo to neural networks approximations of boundary value problems
abstract: arXiv:2209.01432v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper we study probabilistic and neural network approximations for solutions to Poisson equation subject to Holder data in general bounded domains of $\mathbb{R}^d$. We aim at two fundamental goals.   The first, and the most important, we show that the solution to Poisson equation can be numerically approximated in the sup-norm by Monte Carlo methods, and that this can be done highly efficiently if we use a modified version of the walk on spheres algorithm as an acceleration method. This provides estimates which are efficient with respect to the prescribed approximation error and with polynomial complexity in the dimension and the reciprocal of the error. A crucial feature is that the overall number of samples does not not depend on the point at which the approximation is performed. translated_title: 从蒙特卡洛到边界值问题的神经网络近似
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了在$\mathbb{R}^d$的一般有界域中，针对满足Holder数据的泊松方程的概率和神经网络近似解。我们旨在实现两个基本目标。第一个且最重要的目标是，我们证明泊松方程的解可以通过蒙特卡洛方法在sup-范数下进行数值近似，并且如果使用修改版的球面行走算法作为加速方法，这一过程可以高效实现。这提供了相对于预设近似误差高效的估计，并在维数和误差倒数方面具有多项式复杂度。一个关键特征是总样本数量不依赖于近似执行点的位置。作为第二个目标，我们证明所获得的蒙特卡洛求解器以构造性方式生成ReLU深度神经网络（DNN）解。
tldr: 本文提出了一种高效蒙特卡洛方法用于近似泊松方程解，并证明该方法可构造性生成ReLU深度神经网络解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient Monte Carlo method for approximating Poisson equation solutions and demonstrates that it constructively yields ReLU deep neural network solutions.
